def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().strip().split('\n')
    
    n, V = map(int, data[0].split())
    max_difference = float('-inf')
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        l, w, h = map(int, data[i].split())
        vi = l * w * h
        di = vi - V
        if di >= 0:
            max_difference = max(max_difference, di)
    
    print(max_difference)

import sys

def check_box_capacity(boxes, V):
    max_volume = 0
    for l, w, h in boxes:
        volume = l * w * h
        max_volume = max(max_volume, volume)
    return max_volume - V

def main():
    n, V = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    boxes = [tuple(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n)]
    result = check_box_capacity(boxes, V)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def find_largest_box_difference():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().strip().split()

    n = int(data[0])
    V = int(data[1])
    
    max_difference = float('-inf')

    index = 2
    for _ in range(n):
        l = int(data[index])
        w = int(data[index + 1])
        h = int(data[index + 2])
        index += 3
        
        volume = l * w * h
        difference = volume - V
        if difference > max_difference:
            max_difference = difference

    print(max_difference)
